part.text:
The images are ready. ✅

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the workspace defines exactly one view (`SystemContext`), so there's one image.

A note on how it was produced: this environment has no PlantUML/Java/Graphviz/ImageMagick and no external network access (the public PlantUML server is unreachable), so I couldn't run the standard Structurizr → PlantUML → PNG pipeline. Instead I exported the view's definition via the Structurizr tools and rendered it as a hand-built C4-style SVG (your "PNG *or* SVG" option), including:

- **Patron** (person, C4 blue `#084270`) with description
- **Library** (software system, `#1168bd`) with monitor icon and description
- The **Patron → Library** relationship labeled "Browses the catalogue through" with `[HTTPS]`
- Title and a small legend, matching the C4-PlantUML look

If you'd prefer actual PNGs, the intermediate PlantUML source is trivially regenerable — just run it through any PlantUML renderer (e.g. `plantuml SystemContext.puml`) on a machine with Java or network access, and I can produce that file for you.
